name: Seated EZ-Bar Overhead Extension
cues: Sit upright with the bench back set vertical
Hold the bar overhead on its angled grips, hands close
Lower the bar behind your head with your elbows pointing up
Straighten your arms while your upper arms stay still

qa.note: Wave 3c 2026-10-09: rated ok by the lane review, auto-approved. needs work: The bake itself is right (elbow 126 at t 0.5). But the shipped QA hero sheet shows a top pose at t=0.500, so it isn't valid evidence. The upper arm also twists a lot over the rep: humeral rotation runs 152 to 81 (71 deg) and forearm pronation -9 to 84 (93 deg), mostly while the elbow is 6 to 33. The humerus angular acceleration peaks at 36.9 rad/s2 and pronation acceleration at 2151 deg/s2 near lockout (frames 97 to 100). Cue 4 says 'upper arms stay still'. | ok: Fixed in triceps/seated-ez.ts. The 2x2 Newton (roll, pronation) is replaced by damped least squares. The humeral roll is held at the bottom's value (found in the context and re-settled after the bench-clearance root), and forearm turn, wrist dev and a small humerus draw-in (weighted) take the bar. The rot DOF still varies a lot (76 to 139), but that is chart degeneracy at 168 to 173 deg elevation. The true long-axis twist (swing-twist about the humerus vs the bottom frame) is 11.8 deg (was 71.2). Pronation runs 50 to 84 (was -9 to 84). The jerk and acceleration gates pass (the reviewer's 2151 deg/s2 pronation spike is gone, and the forearm_l.pro jerk flip from the first attempt is fixed). Grip error is under 5 mm. Cost: the humerus swings in up to 5.4 deg at lockout (elbow x moves 31 mm), which is within the template's upper-arm-still test (under 6). Wrist dev reaches its 20 deg limit at lockout. QA hero sheet and figure stills were re-rendered from the new bake: the bottom pose (elbow about 132) sits at t 0.5 to 0.625, matching the bake.
